# Bitcoin Mining Stock

> > Comprehensive tracker of Bitcoin mining stocks, corporate Bitcoin treasuries, and digital asset holdings across global exchanges including NASDAQ, HKSE, and JPX.

Bitcoin Mining Stock provides real-time data on public companies holding Bitcoin and Ethereum, tracking treasury holdings, hash rates, market valuations, and mNAV metrics. The platform covers mining operations like CleanSpark and Gryphon Digital Mining, plus corporate treasury adopters across North America, Asia, and Europe.

## Key Topics

- Bitcoin treasury holdings
- Corporate Bitcoin adoption
- Bitcoin mining stocks
- Hash rate metrics
- Market-to-NAV (mNAV) ratios
- NASDAQ-listed miners
- Ethereum corporate holdings
- CleanSpark operations
- HKSE digital asset stocks
- Japanese crypto companies (JPX)
- Renewable energy mining
- BTC treasury data
- Cryptocurrency stock valuations
- Global exchange listings
- Digital asset equities
